title: Event envelope (v1)
description: The part of every SteakLLM event that is the same regardless of type. Readers validate this first, then the event-specific schema. Unknown fields are tolerated on purpose: v1 may gain optional fields, never lose or retype one.

id.description: Unique per event (UUID). Consumers deduplicate on it: Kafka and S3 both deliver at least once.

type.description: Which event this is. Facts in the past tense.

version.description: Contract version of the whole event. 1 is frozen: additive changes only; a breaking change is version 2 in a new file.

time.description: When the fact became true, RFC 3339 in UTC (must end in Z). Producers set it; consumers never rewrite it.

doc_id.description: sha256 of the document bytes, lowercase hex. The same file always gets the same id. Null only for ChatCompleted, which is about a conversation, not a document.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id (32 lowercase hex). Follows one user request across every service and every event it causes.

source.description: The service that wrote the event.

data.description: The event-specific body. Shaped by the per-event schema (<Type>.v1).
